items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We liked Shostakovich, we loved Shostakovich.

ctx.x: And maybe that’s why we both went to Los Angeles or something. We shared the same taste in music, we liked the same composers. We liked Shostakovich, we loved
Shostakovich. And... who else did we like... Ah! Erik Satie.
